_note: Only for the claude.ai preview (dist/preview.html); never on the real site. build.py adds these to src/seed.json there. The particulars and the first section come from src/seed.json's profile; the images are rendered from the game's model by tools/example_plates.js. None of them is mature; two are flagged so the preview shows how a mature image is covered.

sections.heading: The construct
sections.body: An archival construct of Shadowlands make, bought from a broker who asked no questions and answered fewer.

sections.heading: An example section
sections.body:
This page holds examples for the preview. Unseal the archive with the word “preview” and choose Amend this page to see how his own particulars and sections are written.
Nothing written here is kept: a reload brings the examples back.

art.title: Example: the construct, facing
art.note: An example plate, only in the preview. The real site starts with no plates. It has three images: the main one and two alternate versions, the last flagged as mature to show how it is covered.

art.title: Example: a plate flagged as mature
art.note: Its main image is flagged as mature, so the list shows only its cover. (It is not really mature: it is here to show the cover and the age check.)
